title: Roundup inserter: standing rules for which items go in (type, three stars, recency, non-duplication)
description:
**Goal.** A roundup never contains junk, and fills itself. Today `items_in_window` in `src/papyrus_content/newsletter/roundup.py` takes every published non-issue Item in the window, so wiki pages and unrated items count. The automatic inserter must add only qualifying items, into the machine-owned slots of the living issue Story (PPY-4108ef), never into human-edited text.

**Standing rules for what the inserter adds (procedural, no arbitrary numbers).**
1. **Type.** A list declares the Story types it carries (`types: ["article", ...]`; no default of "everything"). Wiki pages, retired Stories and held drafts (a Story whose newest version is an unpublished draft: only the published version can appear) are never candidates.
2. **Quality.** The three-star floor (PPY-0e8d66): the item's effective human rating is at or above the site floor. Unrated and AI-only never qualify.
3. **Recency.** The window is learned from the cadence, not a number of days: from the previous sent issue of this list (or the start of the first period) to now. An item belongs to the window by when it became eligible, the later of its publication and the moment it reached the floor, so a late-rated older article counts as new when it gets its third star, and an item already sent in an earlier issue is never offered again.
4. **Non-duplication.** Using the Reference dedupe groups (same document, same story, related): at most one entry per same-document or same-story group, in the issue and across issues; the first eligible wins and later ones are listed under Left out as duplicates. "Related" does not dedupe.
5. **Placement.** Into the section slot of the item; order inside a slot is the shared quality ranking (PPY-85fdba, called as a module, not re-implemented), except a person's order pin wins.
6. **Exclusions and pins.** Anything a person excluded for this issue is never added back; a pinned entry is never moved or changed (PPY-4108ef).
7. **When it runs.** On change, not by scanning: when an item reaches the floor, is rated down, is retired, or a duplicate group changes, coalesced in short windows (shorter right after a human action). It stops while the issue is approved and resumes if the issue returns to draft. With nothing eligible it adds nothing; an issue with no entries cannot be approved.

**Candidate view.** The Story shows what was included (with why and when), what was left out and why (below floor, duplicate, excluded by a person with their reason, already sent, wrong type), so an editor steers by restoring or removing.

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: The inserter fills the issue
  Scenario: Declared types only
    Given a roundup list that declares the article type
    Then only published articles qualify

  Scenario: Wiki pages
    Given a published wiki page in the window
    Then it is never added

  Scenario: Retired stories
    Given a Story retired after it qualified
    Then its entry is removed with the reason retired

  Scenario: Held drafts
    Given a Story whose newest version is an unpublished draft
    Then the draft is not used and only the published version can appear

  Scenario: Three-star floor
    Given a published article nobody rated
    Then it is not added and the Story lists it as below the floor

  Scenario: Window from the cadence
    Given a weekly list and an issue sent last Monday
    Then candidates are the items that became eligible since that send
    And no fixed number of days is configured anywhere

  Scenario: Late rated, older article
    Given an article published a month ago and rated three stars today
    Then it is added to this week's issue once, and not again in later issues

  Scenario: Already sent
    Given an item that was in last week's issue
    Then it is not added to this week's issue

  Scenario: Duplicate story group
    Given two articles of the same story group
    Then only the first eligible one is added and the other is listed as a duplicate

  Scenario: Excluded by a person
    Given an editor excluded an item from this issue
    Then the inserter never adds it back to this issue

  Scenario: Quality order inside a slot
    Given several qualifying articles in one section
    Then they appear in the shared quality order, except where a person pinned a position

  Scenario: Human text untouched
    When the inserter runs
    Then it changes no subject, intro, outro, heading or pinned entry

  Scenario: Approved issue
    Given the issue is approved for a time
    Then the inserter adds nothing until the issue returns to draft

  Scenario: Nothing eligible
    When no Story qualifies
    Then the issue has no entries, it cannot be approved, and admins are told at the end of the period

  Scenario: Candidate view
    When an editor opens the issue
    Then they see what was included, what was left out and why
```

**Depends on:** PPY-0e8d66 (three-star floor); PPY-85fdba (ranking module); PPY-4108ef (the living issue Story, blocks, exclusions, approval).
**Related:** features_backend/newsletter-roundup.feature (update, do not duplicate), the Reference dedupe groups, PPY-85fdba.

**Answered by the new design:** the cap on items per issue is not a number: the floor, the window and the editor's cuts decide, nothing else.

**Open questions for Ryan:** (1) Should posts ever be in a roundup, or articles only? Proposed: articles only until a list declares otherwise. (2) When two articles are about the same story, first in wins (proposed), or the higher-rated one, even if that swaps a machine entry already shown to editors?

comments.text: Rewritten 2026-11-12: now the inserter's standing rules (type, three-star floor, recency learned from the cadence, non-duplication by dedupe groups, quality order, exclusions, run on change). Blocked by the three-star floor PPY-0e8d66. The living Story, blocks and contribution rules live in PPY-4108ef, not duplicated here.
